mentions.name: ottex.ai
mentions.description: Free BYOK (bring-your-own-key) AI shortcut app offered as an alternative to WisprFlow and Raycast AI shortcuts, providing native macOS and iOS apps that work with OpenRouter keys at similar quality to proprietary products for $1-3 per month instead of $35.
mentions.problem: Proprietary AI assistant products like WisprFlow and Raycast AI shortcuts cost around $35 per month.
mentions.source_excerpt:
ottex.ai - free BYOK alternative to WisprFlow and Raycast AI shortcuts.

Native macOS and iOS apps with OpenRouter BYOK. Same quality as in proprietary products for 1-3$ per month instead of 35$.
